name: PocketPal AI
description: Open-source assistant that runs language models on the phone itself, offline after a model download, with on-device voice input and text-to-speech. Android and iPhone.
research_notes: Network in this session blocked every web host (Play Store, App Store, project sites, WebFetch); only git access to public GitHub repos worked. All facts from the official GitHub README (shallow git clone, last commit 2026-11-13): MIT license, 'runs entirely on your phone', 'download a model once' and works offline with no account, GGUF models (Gemma, Qwen, Phi, Llama), Whisper voice input, App Store and Google Play links in the README badges. README: chat, models, voices and tools are free; store builds offer an optional one-time 'PocketPal Plus' purchase (hands-free voice); payment route for Plus not stated, so payment_methods left unknown. Optional online features (web search, remote server) exist. Store listings themselves not fetched; countries unknown.

access.free_limits: Chat, models, voices and tools free with no account; optional one-time PocketPal Plus purchase in store builds for hands-free voice (included in builds from source).

name: Layla
description: Assistant running language and Stable Diffusion image models on the phone, offline after the model download; one-time purchase, with a limited free Android APK. Android and iPhone.
research_notes: Network in this session blocked every web host (Play Store, App Store, project sites, WebFetch); only git access to public GitHub repos worked. Closed source; no page could be fetched. Facts from WebSearch result snippets of the US App Store listing (id6456886656): runs LLMs and Stable Diffusion models on device with no need for internet, USD 19.99 with in-app purchases, downloads a 4GB model on first start. Google Play package com.layla appeared directly as a play.google.com search result; price there not confirmed. A free 'Layla Lite' (com.laylalite) is mentioned only by third parties (AlternativeTo, APKPure), so not listed. Official site layla-network.ai from search results/Product Hunt; publisher name 'Layla Network' taken from the site name, unconfirmed. A separate 'Layla (Cloud)' App Store app exists and is not this listing. Re-verify by fetching store pages. Verification review 2026-11-16: compared with the official pages fetched that day (3 pages); 13 quoted confirmations, corrected or added: access.free, access.free_limits, access.payment_methods, publisher_region, interface_languages, description. Official site says there is a free limited version (direct APK) and the full app is a one-time purchase, so free status changes from paid_only to free_tier and 'Paid' is dropped from the description; Google Play price US$19.99 now confirmed; developer address in Australia.

access.free_limits: Free version with limited features as a direct Android APK; the full app is a one-time purchase (US$19.99 on the App Store and Google Play in the US). Optional in-app plans (Monarch, Birdwing, Blue Morpho, from US$4.99) on the App Store, and Layla Cloud hosted models.

value.note: Paid app on the App Store and Google Play (US$19.99 in the US stores), plus App Store in-app plans

name: Locally AI
description: Free iPhone, iPad and Mac app running open models such as Llama, Gemma and Qwen on the device with Apple's MLX, offline, without login.
research_notes: Network in this session blocked every web host (Play Store, App Store, project sites, WebFetch); only git access to public GitHub repos worked.
